postDeploy: chmod 0755 /srv/cb-vpn/firewall.sh /srv/cb-vpn/entrypoint.sh && install -m 0644 /srv/cb-vpn/cb-vpn.service /etc/systemd/system/cb-vpn.service && systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable cb-vpn && systemctl restart cb-vpn
notes: Proxy is published on the tailnet address only; the healthcheck must be run from a tailnet member (the laptop), not from the VPS. Credentials live in /srv/cb-vpn/.env (mode 600) on the server and are not in the repo.
